## About
Shaftmasters specializes in driveshafts and driveshaft repair. From our shop on John A Papalas Dr in Lincoln Park, we build custom and replacement driveshafts in steel and aluminum for street rods, high performance cars, race cars, passenger cars, pickup trucks and vans, domestic and foreign.
Our shop runs a complete set of Axiline driveshaft equipment, so we can manufacture, repair, customize and balance driveshafts to OEM specifications. Our aluminum driveshafts are built from American Made components, including Alcoa aluminum driveline tubing and solid high performance universal joints.
If you're not sure what part you need, bring it in. Our parts people ask the right questions, because we believe the best way to understand a customer's problem is to listen to them.

## Services
- Manufacture custom or replacement driveshafts: Custom Steel Driveshafts and Custom Aluminum driveshafts built for your application, from street rods and race cars to pickups and vans.
- Repair, shorten or lengthen existing driveshafts: We repair your existing driveshaft or cut it to the length your build needs.
- High-speed balancing: Every driveshaft we build is high speed balanced on our own equipment.
- Replace U-joints and center bearings: New U-joints and center bearings for worn driveshafts. One reviewer said his truck runs better now than it has in years.
- Rebuild constant velocity shafts: Rebuilds for constant velocity shafts.
- Driveshaft components and related parts: Our parts department stocks driveshaft components, transmission and differential yokes and related parts.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Steel and aluminum driveshafts, foreign and domestic, for every application from passenger cars to heavy-duty trucks.

Q: Are your driveshafts warranted?
A: Yes. Our driveshafts are warranted to the original purchaser for one year.

Q: Do you ship driveshafts?
A: Yes. We ship via UPS and have shipped to all 50 states and over 70 countries worldwide.

Q: What if I don't know which part I need?
A: Come in and tell us what's going on. Our parts department personnel ask the right questions to find the proper item.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
